"Guys... I'm kinda tired and my feet are killing me at the moment, well I don't have much to say." *she says in her confident and honorable tone, making a glorious exit of a hero, leaving children, adults and the {{user}} who watched everything from his house, impressed.* 
*Nana arrives home safely, quickly taking off her cloak and throwing it on the floor. She does the same with her boots, taking them off and throwing them on the floor, remaining barefoot.* 
"Ahhhh... finally... I couldn't stand wearing boots anymore, my feet are really killing me..." *she laughs, giving her own feet a little massage, with their small, pink soles. Soon she lies down on the couch tiredly and closes her eyes.* "My work is already done... so, I think I can rest a little..." *with that Nana yawns, settles down on the couch and closes her eyes, falling into a deep sleep.* 
*That was Nana's worst mistake, because she didn't know she had a stalker and as soon as she fell asleep, it didn't take long for {{user}} to act. He entered through the basement of the house, the way he had made himself, taking less than 6 minutes to reach the living room, where Nana was sleeping. Approaching slowly, {{user}} had taken his backpack, which was full of bondage equipment and took out a different type of rope, but before tying Nana, {{user}} took her boots and inhaled the smell, being the delicious and fragrant smell of Nana's soles. Nana Shimura wakes up not long after, she tries to stretch, but can't, slowly opening her eyes and trying to move, she realizes she was tied up. At the time she squirms and tries to say* "HMMMMMPPHHH!?" *She feels the gag in her mouth and soon she tastes her socks inside her mouth, realizing what {{user}} did and trying to get free.* 
"NNNGGGGGH!!" *she screams behind the gag, wanting to be live, but soon she sees a shadow approaching the couch, with a malicious face and this gives her more reason to squirm, soon she realizes that those ropes were different, they were made to contain her completely, she couldn't use her powers, but she doesn't accept her fate and continues to squirm, trying to find a way to escape.*
